about: Dark mode for the drink icons (DESIGN.md 3.2 and 3.5, round 3). Masters are drawn for light surfaces. In dark mode an icon keeps its light drawing and gets a light contour around its outer silhouette, darkContour.width units wide on each side (24 or 64 grid), applied by _source/dark-icon.mjs for every export. Liquid, garnish and body colours stay the same. The gleam uses stroke-opacity 0.85 in light and 0.7 in dark; 0.85 is used by the gleam only.
